The form $$ジェニオン$$ takes when it activates 'GAI Mode.'
'GAI' stands for 'Glitter Armament Infinity,' a name given by $$ＡＧ$$.
Its existence was not known even to the agent $$ＡＧ$$, and its first activation came about almost by accident.
The pilot's mental state is involved in triggering it. This is thought to be because $$ジェニオン$$'s 'TS-DEMON' must shift into what could be called a second stage, a mode that goes beyond simple control of $$次元力$$ to sense the pilot's emotions and will, and draw out $$次元力$$ through them.
Unlike $$ジェニオン$$, which only used $$次元力$$ as a power source, GAI Mode actively diverts $$次元力$$'s greatest characteristic, phenomenon control, into its weaponry. As a result, its combat strength surpasses $$ジェニオン$$'s, boasting overwhelming destructive power.
At first, the $$次元力$$ drawn out by the second-stage TS-DEMON had a quantitative limit, and this form could be maintained for only about one to two minutes. However, once it seized the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ from $$ジェミニア#robot$$, this problem was resolved. Furthermore, thanks to the pilot's qualities as a Reactor, TS-DEMON was able to control the $$スフィア$$, raising the unit's combat strength beyond what it had ever been.

fixes.new:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by $$ジェミニス$$, which belonged to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
A weapon developed on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$, this high-grade unit was issued on a priority basis to $$ジェミニス$$, the elite corps.
It employs a man-machine interface called psychokinetic control, through which a $$ジェミニス$$ member's psychokinetic power is applied directly to piloting. Because of this, each unit is finely tuned to match its pilot.
By using its various weapons, which draw on light particles extracted through $$次元力$$, with the high responsiveness and mobility afforded by psychokinetic control, it possesses tremendous melee ability. In particular, 'Command Arts,' which reproduces $$ジェミナイ$$'s traditional martial arts through the unit itself, is extremely effective in mobile weapon combat, and $$ディオスク$$, which puts it into practice, stood alongside $$ジェミニア#robot$$ as a symbol of strength to the $$ジェミナイド$$s.
$$アムブリエル$$, who boarded $$ジェミニア#robot$$, used the units left behind in the $$サイデリアル$$ as her own underlings. Because AI was used as the pilot in that case, the psychokinetic control function, its greatest feature, was cut, and its combat strength is lower than when piloted by $$ジェミニス$$ members.
fixes.reason: pronoun: Ambriel is female (brief); the name was repeated only because of the old gender rule (the second $$アムブリエル$$ token is dropped for that reason)

fixes.new:
A custom type of the Axio, a bestselling humanoid mobile weapon.
It is a special-duty model built through thorough weight reduction and enhanced stealth and communication performance, making it an extremely expensive machine.
It has been the favored unit of the special forces $$ファイヤバグ$$ since their days as military personnel, and it is equipped with the electromagnetic melee weapon 'EM Dagger.'
The base Axio unit was known for its excellent handling, but $$ファイヤバグ$$ has tuned this one further, giving it a touchy, high-strung feel to pilot. Put another way, the squad's members, who handle it as naturally as their own limbs, are capable of piloting any mobile weapon.
Incidentally, 'Burglar' means a robber, and when it was sold by the Axion Foundation it went by the name 'Night Bird.'
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 強盗 means robber (armed robbery), not thief
